title: Issue with Streaks Widget Not Displaying Content
body: Dear Streaks Support Team, I am experiencing an issue with the Streaks widget on my iPhone. The widget is not displaying any content, even though the app itself is working fine. I have tried the following troubleshooting steps: Ensured that the app has the necessary permissions (Motion & Fitness, Health data, etc.). Removed and re-added the widget. Restarted my iPhone. Updated Streaks to the latest version. Deleted and reinstalled the app. Despite these attempts, the widget still does not show any data. Could you please provide guidance on how to fix this issue? Thank you for your support!
author: Dennis004
